title: A QUESTION THAT DEMANDS AN ANSWER
theme: Responses to Christ expose religious ambition, material gain, popularity, and a penitent sense of need.
proposition: We must answer what we will do with Jesus by acknowledging our need rather than rejecting Him for selfish motives.
sermonQuestion: What will you do with Jesus?
